Your average price for electricity service will vary 
according to your usage. The price you pay each
month will consist of the Energy Charge, Base 
Charge, and Transmission & Distribution Service 
Provider (TDSP) Charges. Any nonrecurring fees from
the TDSP will be passed through without mark-up.
